def median_filter_2d(image, radius=5):
    """Apply median filtering to reduce noise"""
    result = image.copy().astype(float)
    padded = np.pad(
        image.astype(int), ((radius, radius), (radius, radius)), mode="edge"
    )

    kernel_size = min(3, radius * 2, image.shape[0], image.shape[1])

    for i in range(image.shape[0]):
        for j in range(image.shape[1]):
            window = padded[i - radius : i + radius + 1, j - radius : j + radius + 1]
            window = window.astype(float)
            result[i, j] = np.median(window)

    return result.astype(np.float32) / 255.0
